sourceFacts.fact: Prolonged vomiting can cause hypochloraemic hypokalaemic metabolic alkalosis.
Loss of gastric hydrochloric acid removes hydrogen and chloride; associated volume depletion contributes to maintenance of the disturbance.

layout: Four labelled concepts. Node1 at upper left branches right to node2 then right to node3 across the top row. A separate arrow from node1 travels down to wide bottom node4. Node2 is a plain rectangular inventory with H+ and Cl− paper tokens leaving it on small arrows. Node3 shows a qualitative dial titled Alkaline shift, without numerical scale. Node4 shows fewer water-drop and K+ tokens. Keep all shapes abstract and avoid stomach or kidney. Bottom note: The pattern may be absent early.
